questions.question: According to the reading, what is the essential concept behind the Day of the Dead?
options: People stay at home and avoid cemeteries for two days.
People pray that the dead will never come back.
People mourn the dead quietly in church.
People celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.
questions.answer: People celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.82 第1段：this is the essential concept behind the Mexican festival called the Day of the Dead, when people celebrate death with joy and humor rather than mourn it with sorrow.
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.82 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: On which days is the Day of the Dead celebrated, and who is honored on each day?
options: Nov. 1 for deceased children; Nov. 2 for departed adults
Nov. 1 for departed adults; Nov. 2 for deceased children
questions.answer: Nov. 1 for deceased children; Nov. 2 for departed adults
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.83 第2段：celebrated on November 1 and 2; traditionally deceased children are honored on Nov. 1, while Nov. 2 is reserved for departed adults. p.87 也考「Deceased children are the main focus on the second day」為錯誤敘述。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.83 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: 【多選題】Which of the following do Mexicans buy in local markets in advance to prepare for the souls' arrival? (應選 3 項)
options: (C) decorated sugar skulls bearing the names of the dead
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.83 第2段：they prepare by purchasing items in local markets in advance, such as marigolds, candles, decorated sugar skulls bearing the names of departed family members, and "bread of the dead."
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.83 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: What do families do late in the evening after welcoming the spirits at home?
options: They go to sleep early so the spirits can rest.
They hold a funeral in the church.
They head to the cemetery, decorate the graves, light a candle for each dead person, and feast and pray till dawn.
They burn the altars at home.
questions.answer: They head to the cemetery, decorate the graves, light a candle for each dead person, and feast and pray till dawn.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.84：late in the evening families head to the cemetery, decorate the graves of loved ones and light one candle for each dead person; cheerful and merry, they feast with the honored souls and pray till dawn, transforming the graveyard into a venue of joy. p.87 Comprehension 1 答案即此。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.84 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: "Mexicans aren't mocking death. Instead, they are recognizing it as an inevitable part of the natural cycle." What is the function of "Instead" here?
options: It follows a negative sentence to clarify what people actually do.
questions.answer: It follows a negative sentence to clarify what people actually do.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.82 Language Highlight 與 p.84～85 第4段：作者在否定句之後用轉折詞 Instead 來澄清真正的意思——墨西哥人不是在嘲弄死亡，而是承認它是自然循環中不可避免的一部分。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.84 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: Which best describes the author's attitude toward the Day of the Dead?
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.87 Comprehension 3：作者態度為 Positive；文末說 Hopefully this tradition will never die out…If we cannot escape death, why not celebrate it?

questions.question: 【多選題】According to the timeline, which statements about the history of the Day of the Dead are correct? (應選 3 項)
options: (A) UNESCO added it to the list of Intangible Cultural Heritages of Humanity in 2008.
(B) Mexico City has held an official parade since the 14th century.
(C) The Spanish arrived in 1519 and immediately banned the festival forever.
(D) The Aztecs used skulls to honor the deceased because they believed death was an ever-present part of life.
(E) After the Spanish conquest, the celebrations were moved to All Saints' Day (Nov. 1) and All Souls' Day (Nov. 2).
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.82 時間軸：14 世紀初阿茲提克人定居今墨西哥中部，以頭骨紀念死者；西班牙人 1519 年抵達、兩年後征服帝國，天主教會把慶典移到 11/1 諸聖節、11/2 萬靈節；2008 年列入聯合國教科文組織人類非物質文化遺產；墨西哥市 2016 年才受 2015 年 007 電影啟發開始舉辦官方遊行。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.82 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: On an ofrenda with three levels, what does each level represent?
options: top – underworld; middle – earth; lowest – heaven
top – heaven; middle – earth; lowest – underworld
top – earth; middle – heaven; lowest – underworld
questions.answer: top – heaven; middle – earth; lowest – underworld
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.81：ofrenda 頂層代表天堂（死者照片、聖徒像、聖母、耶穌），中層代表人間（死者生前愛吃的食物飲料），底層代表冥界（蠟燭與香驅邪，水和毛巾讓死者梳洗）。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.81 的內容命題，非課本原題）

questions.question: The reading strategy "Annotating" in Lesson 4 means ____.
options: reading a text as fast as possible without stopping
marking a text—highlighting key points, circling new words, writing responses—to reorganize information in your own way
questions.answer: marking a text—highlighting key points, circling new words, writing responses—to reorganize information in your own way

questions.question: 【多選題】Which sentences use the word correctly? (應選 2 項)
options: (B) He prefers to swim than to run.
(C) The graveyard is transformed into a venue of joy.
(D) Many people participate in the street parades.

questions.question: Mexicans recognize death as part of the natural cycle and would rather embrace it ____ ignore it.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.98 Language in Use：would rather + VR + than + VR ＝ would + VR + rather than + VR，表達偏好。例：Ryan would rather be a little nobody than become an evil somebody.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: Joy would rather to go to Tainan than drive.
Joy would rather going to Tainan than driving.
Joy would rather go to Tainan rather than drive.
Joy would go to Tainan by high-speed rail rather than drive for three hours.
questions.answer: Joy would go to Tainan by high-speed rail rather than drive for three hours.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.98：would rather 後接原形動詞，than 後也接原形；另一寫法是 would + VR + rather than + VR。不可寫成 would rather to V 或 would rather…rather than。
questions.reference: AI 自編（依長榮高中高二英文課本 Lesson 4 Day of the Dead p.98 的內容命題，非課本原題）
